what.text: This page follows refugees from Russia in all host countries combined, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 99360 refugees from Russia.
France hosts the largest share, 37.0%, followed by Germany, the United States and Austria.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Chechnya territory in Russia from 1994 to 1996 and from 1999 to 2007, with the Chechen Republic of Ichkeria, at war level in several years.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Russia in 1993 and from 2023 to 2024, with LSR, RDK and Wagner in the later period.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1964 at 120 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 251394, at the end of 1994, and the main years of displacement in the data are 1991 to 1998 and 2006.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country, reported to UNHCR.
